description: Implementation of the android::binder::Status class, including methods for creating, serializing, and converting status objects, as well as handling exceptions and error codes within the Android binder framework.

classes.name: Status
classes.description: Represents the status of an operation, including error codes, exception types, and messages, with methods for serialization and conversion.

methods.name: ok
methods.description: Returns a Status object representing success (no error).

methods.name: fromExceptionCode
methods.description: Creates a Status object based on an exception code, with overloads for message input.

methods.name: fromServiceSpecificError
methods.description: Creates a Status object for a service-specific error with optional message.

methods.name: fromStatusT
methods.description: Creates a Status object from a system status_t value.

methods.name: exceptionToString
methods.description: Converts an exception code to its string representation.

methods.name: readFromParcel
methods.description: Deserializes a Status object from a Parcel.

methods.name: writeToParcel
methods.description: Serializes a Status object into a Parcel.

methods.name: writeOverParcel
methods.description: Writes the Status object into a Parcel, resetting data size and position.

methods.name: setException
methods.description: Sets the exception type and message for the Status.

methods.name: setServiceSpecificError
methods.description: Sets the Status as a service-specific error with a message.

methods.name: setFromStatusT
methods.description: Initializes the Status object from a system status_t value.

methods.name: toString8
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Status object.
